text.text_excerpt: What I loved most about this location was that it wasn't packed like the one on St. Claude on the weekdays. The cashier did explain that it does get busy in the east, particularly on Sundays. The price for one was about $7.00 which at first, seemed pretty expensive. However, the portion given was huge! And they also have 20 free toppings that you can pile onto your rolled ice cream! I ordered the strawberry shorty and it definitely exceeded my expectations due to its creamy texture! Loved every bite and will come again soon!

I came here and was pleasantly surprised. At first I thought the $6.35 charge was high but they serve you a good amount of ice cream so I was content after receiving it. The staff, all young high schoolers, were very engaging and funny. The ice cream itself was delicious. Absolutely amazing in fact. I will definitely be coming back. Added bonus is the toppings are for free. I know many an ice cream place that will charge extra per topping to squeeze every cent out you they can, so it was very nice to see this business offer free toppings.

A nice, new place to get decent rolled ice cream in New Orleans East. Ambiance: Located in a strip mall complex, Freezy Street has a decent, clean look with teal painted walls. Menu was colorfully written on chalkboards and cereal boxes were prominently displayed to add to the color of the space. It was made even more fun and colorful with brightly colored chairs. There were also clear window panes to see the ice cream being freshly rolled and then a separate area to add toppings. However, it has more of a low-scale feel with an air conditioning unit in full view of customers and diner tables and chairs.
